summary: Performance optimization verified. Vectorized pandas processing works correctly and is fast. Uploaded 3 PO files of different sizes with stock + sales; all completed well under the 60s target. Calculations validated as identical/accurate.
passed: POST /api/upload with 32-row PO + stock + sales -> 200 in 0.69s (total round trip)
POST /api/upload with 1280-row synthetic PO -> 200 in 1.93s (total items=1280, needs_review=720)
POST /api/upload with 6400-row synthetic PO -> 200 in 6.55s (well under 60s Cloudflare limit)
Vectorized calculations correct: Production Cost=UC*0.4, Commission=UC*commission_fr%, Total Cost/Unit sum, Margin/Unit and Margin % match hand-calculated values (33.0 -> 22.62 / 10.38 / 31.45%)
Stock Quantity and Sales Units (30d) columns populated from ASIN lookup (dict.map)
Status field derived correctly (APPROVED / NEEDS_REVIEW) based on margin thresholds

All expected result columns present: PO, Vendor, Ship to Location, ASIN, External ID, Model Number, Title, Quantity, Unit Cost, Production Cost, UPS Cost, Operational Cost, Commission, Total Cost/Unit, Margin/Unit, Margin %, Total Cost, Total Margin, Stock Quantity, Sales Units (30d), Status, Needs Review

failed.issue: Timing log lines ('Loaded X rows in Ys', 'Calculated margins for X items in Ys') are not visible in supervisor backend logs because root logger has no basicConfig/level set; logging.info() messages are suppressed. Performance itself is fine, only observability of the added timing log is missing.
failed.evidence: grep -E 'Loaded|Calculated margins' /var/log/supervisor/backend.*.log returned no matches, though /api/upload consistently returns 200 in <2s for 1280 rows and <7s for 6400 rows.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO) (or configure the root/uvicorn logger) at the top of backend/server.py so the newly added timing logs are actually written to stdout/supervisor logs. Functionality is unaffected; this is purely for observability of the performance timings called out in the request.
notes: Requested test files (EditLineItems.xlsx, Inventory.xlsx, Sales.xlsx in /tmp/) were not present in the sandbox, so testing used the existing PO/stock/sales fixtures under /app/uploads/ plus synthetically enlarged variants (1280 and 6400 rows) to stress-test the vectorized path. The 2.7MB / large-file Cloudflare 524 scenario is effectively covered because processing time scales linearly and is comfortably < 60s even at 6400 rows.
